name: The Broken Approach

npcs.name: Rico Dela Cruz
dialogue: The earthquake, landslide, and coastal warnings are all active.
Use sturdy cover during shaking, then follow the checked route inland.
after_dialogue: The route is holding. Keep the group together and follow updates from responders.

choice.prompt: The road has cracked and the slope is unstable. Which approach?

options.result: The team reaches the facility without entering the slide zone.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: The damaged slope may collapse again.
options.consequence: You crossed below an unstable slope.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue: The slope blocked the road and I hurt my leg trying to get clear.
Please bring the radio so I can call the team, then carry me to high ground.
after_dialogue: The response team heard my call. Please carry me along the marked safe route.
rescue_dialogue: I cannot walk safely with my injured leg. Bring the emergency radio, then carry me to the marked route, away from the unstable slope.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. Please carry me to the marked route, away from the unstable slope.
npcs.rescue_hint: Collect the emergency radio, then speak with Dr. Mira Santos again.

npcs.name: Mang Lito
dialogue: The ground is cracking near the coast, and the sea is pulling back.
Help me pass the tsunami warning to the shelter. We must move uphill.
after_dialogue: The warning reached the shelter. Stay inland and away from the river valleys.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the first-aid kit. Please bring it, then help me get to the marked route, away from the unstable slope.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the marked route, away from the unstable slope now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the first-aid kit, then speak with Mang Lito again.

quests.title: Help Dr. Mira Santos call the response team
Check in with Rico Dela Cruz
Find eye protection before crossing the ash and debris route.
Find First-aid kit for the response team
Rescue Mang Lito and get them to safety

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_pilar: Find Dr. Mira Santos and give her the radio so she can call the response team.
quests.community: Find Rico Dela Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach the marked inland safe zone.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Learn local landslide warning signs, hazard maps, and evacuation routes before heavy rain.
If a slide threatens, avoid its path and move to a safe area as directed by local officials.
After a slide, stay away from the affected slope because further movement may occur.

quiz.question: You see signs of a possible landslide near your route. What is safest?
options: Avoid the slide path and move to a safe area following local instructions
Go closer to inspect the slope
Cross the debris to reach the road
quiz.explanation: Avoid landslide paths, move to a safe area, and follow local authority guidance.

briefing: An earthquake cracks the approach road and weakens nearby slopes. Protect yourself during shaking, then move clear of damaged structures. Take a longer stable route around the landslide; report trapped people rather than entering unstable debris.
story_clue: The team confirms the World Engine is destabilizing natural systems.
